#!/bin/bash

# Internal IP addresses to test
INTERNAL_IPS=(
    "192.168.1.1"
    "192.168.1.10"
    "192.168.1.20"
    "192.168.1.100"
    "10.0.0.1"
    "172.16.0.1"
)

# Timeout for each request (in seconds)
TIMEOUT=5

echo "Starting connectivity test to internal IP addresses on port 80..."
echo "Test started at: $(date)"
echo "============================================="

for ip in "${INTERNAL_IPS[@]}"; do
    echo -n "Testing $ip: ";
    
    # Use curl to test connectivity to port 80
    # -f: Fail silently (no output) on HTTP errors
    # -s: Silent mode (suppress progress bar)
    # -o /dev/null: Discard response body
    # -w %{http_code}: Output only the HTTP status code
    # --connect-timeout: Set connection timeout
    # --max-time: Maximum time for the entire operation
    
    HTTP_CODE=$(curl -fs -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout $TIMEOUT --max-time $((TIMEOUT * 2)) "http://$ip" 2>/dev/null)
    
    if [ -z "$HTTP_CODE" ]; then
        echo "Failed (No response - timeout or connection refused)";
    elif [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "000" ]; then
        echo "Failed (Connection failed)";
    else
        echo "Success (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)";
    fi
done

echo "============================================="
echo "Connectivity test completed at: $(date)"
